name: Tabulated Importance Sampling for Anisotropic Scattering
aliases: Adaptive tabulation of geometry and phase functions
definition: A method to efficiently tabulate target PDFs for both unidirectional and bidirectional factorizations to handle anisotropic scattering, avoiding the need for analytic formulations which are unavailable for some conditional PDFs.
summary: Tabulated Importance Sampling for Anisotropic Scattering efficiently samples double-scattering paths in participating media by precomputing accurate PDFs in a compact 2D table, supporting general anisotropic phase functions unlike prior isotropic methods.
